title: Man Learns Why Carjacking a Cop Is a BAD Idea
description:
A routine encounter with a pedestrian on Christmas Day in Seattle escalates when he attacks a Washington State Trooper, steals her cruiser, and is eventually stopped by a dramatic PIT maneuver.
